data.original_title: ENGAGEMENT OF SPECIALIST CADRE OFFICERS ON CONTRACT BASIS ADVERTISEMENT NO: CRPD/SCO/2025-26/20 INTERVIEW SCHEDULE
data.summary: The interview schedule for engagement of Specialist Cadre Officers on a contract basis under advertisement CRPD/SCO/2025-26/20 has been released. Interviews will be conducted on 17 March 2026 and 18 March 2026 at the State Bank Global IT Centre in Navi Mumbai. Candidates are required to report at 09:30 AM.
data.article_html:
Interview Schedule

The official notification for the engagement of Specialist Cadre Officers on a contract basis (Advertisement No: CRPD/SCO/2025-26/20) has released the interview schedule.

Interviews are scheduled across two days: on 17 March 2026 for the position of AVP (Learning and Development) and on 18 March 2026 for the position of AVP (Manpower Planning and Recruitment). All interviews will be held at the State Bank Global IT Centre, Board Room, Tower-1, Second Floor, C Wing, L&T Seawoods Railway Station Building, Sector-40, Navi Mumbai - 400706, with reporting time at 09:30 AM.

Candidates should note the venue and reporting time and arrive well before the scheduled time.

data.title: Madhya Pradesh Forest Service Main Exam 2026 Online Application
data.original_title: Online Application Link - State Forest Service Main Exam 2026
data.summary: The Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission has opened online applications for the State Forest Service Main Exam 2026. Candidates can apply from 24 July 2026 up to 31 December 2025, with the exam scheduled for 27 September 2026. Admit cards will be issued subsequently.
data.article_html:
Online Application Link - State Forest Service Main Exam 2026

The Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission has released the online application link for the State Forest Service Main Exam 2026. Candidates can submit their applications through the official portal until the last date of application.

  • Application Start: 24 July 2026
  • Application Deadline: 31 December 2025
  • Exam Date: 27 September 2026
  • Admit Card: To be released soon

Eligible candidates with the required qualification are advised to apply before the deadline. For detailed instructions and frequently asked questions, visit the official website.

Eligible bidder asking for the minimum %share or claiming least share of TC/TAC will be awarded the contract where the quoted% rates will be evaluated as follows: (i) If a bidder quotes 100%, it shall mean in effect that bidder claims to be allocated 100% of the TC and TAC amount and IR will retain 'Nil' share of the TC/TAC. (ii) If a bidder quotes 1-99% e.g. 10%, it shall mean in effect that bidder claims to be allocated 10% of the TC/TAC amount, as GCTO share; and remaining 90% being allocated to the IR. (iv) If a bidder quotes in negative, e.g. (-)30%, it means that entire 100% of TC and/or TAC will be retained by IR. Over and above, the GCTO will pay an amount equivalent to 30% of TC and/or TAC to IR. (v) Thus, if five bids are received with quotes 100%, 30%, 0%, -20% and -40%; in such case, -40% is the minimum bid, and this bidder shall be awarded the contract. A single percentage offer rate must be quoted by the bidder for Terminal Charges & Terminal Access Charges (TC & TAC). 4. The maximum share which the bidder can claim is by quoting a rate of 100% of TC/TAC. In case the bidder quotes more than "100%" then the bid shall be rejected. The quoted percentage rates will be evaluated as follows: Say for example, (i) If a bidder quotes "100%", it shall mean in effect that bidder claims to be allocated 100% of the TC and TAC amount, and that DFCCIL/IR will retain "nil" share of TC/TAC. (ii) If a bidder quotes 10 %, it shall mean that bidder claims to be allocated [10%] of TC/TAC amount (as mentioned cell 1B of the table), as GCTO share, and remaining 90% being allocated to DFCCIL/IR. (iii) If bidder quotes "-30%", it means that entire 100% of TC and/or TAC will be retained by Indian Railways. Over and above, the GCTO will pay an amount equivalent to 30% of TC and/or TAC to DFCCIL/IR. For eg., if five bids are received with rates quoted as "100%", "30%", "0%, "-20", and -40% in such case "-40%" is the minimum bid. data.article_html:
Notice Inviting Tender – Gati Shakti Multi‑Modal Cargo Terminal

The Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) has issued a tender (No. HQ-OPBD0BDGFTD112023-D) for planning, constructing, developing and operating a Gati Shakti Multi‑Modal Cargo Terminal (GCT) on goods line No. 4 towards Ambala on DFCCIL railway land. The bid submission closes on 2026‑09‑15 at 15:00 hrs, with a pre‑bid conference on 2026‑08‑17 at 15:30 hrs.

  • Tender Type: Normal Open Two‑Packet System
  • Bidding Unit: Percentage share of Terminal Charges and Terminal Access Charges
  • Earnest Money: Rs. 33,340,300.00
  • Validity of Offer: 90 days
  • Eligibility: Minimum two years experience in manufacturing, transportation or logistics; net worth ≥ 50 % of project cost

structured_data.article_html:
Final Result for Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) – Advertisement No.01/DR/2025

The Department of DFCCIL has declared the final result for the Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) recruitment against Advertisement No.01/DR/2025. Candidates can view their scores and download the result PDF from the official portal.

  • Result published on the DFCCIL career page.
  • Download link available on the website.
  • No further recruitment process is pending for this advertisement.

For more details, refer to the official notification.

data.summary: Candidates awaiting the Junior Executive/S&T position at DFCCIL should note the document verification schedule announced. The verification will take place over a 10‑day period in October 2023 across multiple cities. Ensure you review the dates and prepare the required documents.
data.article_html:

data.article_html:
Notice Inviting Tender – DFCCIL

The Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) has issued a public notice inviting tenders for the shifting of signalling and OFC cables at Unjha Station on the PNUN-ADI section. The work includes supply, preparation, splicing and installation of various fibre optic cables and associated accessories as per detailed specifications.

  • Tender No: DFC-ADI-SNT-01-2026-27
  • Closing Date & Time: 31/08/2026 15:00 Hrs
  • Bids must be submitted electronically; manual offers will be ignored
  • Pre‑Bid Conference: Not applicable
  • Earnest Money: Rs. 36,800
  • Validity of Offer: 60 days

Notice Inviting Tender for Gati Shakti Multi‑Modal Cargo Terminal

The Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) has issued a tender under No HQ-OPBD0BDGFTD112023-D to Plan, Construct, Develop & Operate a Gati Shakti Multi‑Modal Cargo Terminal (GCT) for handling cargo on the goods line No. 4 towards Ambala end of New Shambhu station on DFCCIL/Railway Land. NIT HEADER  Name of Work  Plan, Construct, Develop & Operate Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal (GCT) for handling Cargo on goods line no. 4 towards Ambala end of New Shambhu station on DFCCIL/Railway Land" Under Schedule- '2' of GCT Policy of Indian Railways. SCHEDULE  S.No.   Item Code Item Qty   Qty Unit   Unit Rate   Basic Value   Escl.(%)   Amount   Bidding Unit Schedule   () A-Plan, Construct, Develop & Operate Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal (GCT) for handling Cargo on goods line no. 4 towards Ambala end of New Shambhu station on DFCCIL/Railway Land -   - Lump Sum   -   -   -   -  Page 1 of 4   Run Date/Time: 05/08/2026 17:22:10  CORPORATE OFFICE-OP AND BD/DFC CORPORATE OFFICE TENDER DOCUMENT  Tender No:   HQ-OPBD0BDGFTD112023-D   Closing Date/Time:   15/09/2026 15:00
1  Description :-   (Please see Annexure-VIII of RFP) i) The bidder shall fill the rate at the designated field in IREPS. Quoting rate anywhere in the bid except at the designated field of IREPS shall not be considered for evaluation. ii) Bidder has to quote the rate only in the financial packet of Bid, quoting rate in the technical packet would render the bid summarily rejected. iii) "Bidder will be required to quote the percentage in share of Terminal Charge and Terminal Access Charges (TC/TAC) which they will claim from the Railway for all traffic handled at the Terminal. Eligible bidder asking for the minimum %share or claiming least share of TC/TAC will be awarded the contract where the quoted% rates will be evaluated as follows: (i) If a bidder quotes 100%, it shall mean in effect that bidder claims to be allocated 100% of the TC and TAC amount and IR will retain 'Nil' share of the TC/TAC. (ii) If a bidder quotes 1-99% e.g. 10%, it shall mean in effect that bidder claims to be allocated 10% of the TC/TAC amount, as GCTO share; and remaining 90% being allocated to the IR. (iii) If a bidder quotes "0 (Nil)%", it shall mean in effect that Bidder claims to be allocated 'Nil' share in TC/TAC amount, as GCTO share. Over and above, the GCTO will pay an amount equivalent to 30% of TC and/or TAC to IR. (v) Thus, if five bids are received with quotes 100%, 30%, 0%, -20% and -40%; in such case, -40% is the minimum bid, and this bidder shall be awarded the contract. The quoted percentage rates will be evaluated as follows: Say for example, (i) If a bidder quotes "100%", it shall mean in effect that bidder claims to be allocated 100% of the TC and TAC amount, and that DFCCIL/IR will retain "nil" share of TC/TAC. (ii) If a bidder quotes 10 %, it shall mean that bidder claims to be allocated [10%] of TC/TAC amount (as mentioned cell 1B of the table), as GCTO share, and remaining 90% being allocated to DFCCIL/IR. (iii) If bidder quotes "-30%", it means that entire 100% of TC and/or TAC will be retained by Indian Railways. Over and above, the GCTO will pay an amount equivalent to 30% of TC and/or TAC to DFCCIL/IR. For eg., if five bids are received with rates quoted as "100%", "30%", "0%, "-20", and -40% in such case "-40%" is the minimum bid. data.title: DFCCIL Invites Tender for Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal
data.original_title: Notice Inviting Tender [54KB]
data.qualification: Two years experience in manufacturing, transportation or logistics
data.summary: DFCCIL on behalf of the President of India invites bids for the design, construction, development and operation of a Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal at Ambala. Bids must be submitted by 15 September 2026. The pre-bid conference is scheduled for 17 August 2026.
data.article_html:
Notice Inviting Tender HQ-OPBD0BDGFTD112023-D

The President of India, through DFCCIL, invites bids for the design, construction, development and operation of a Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal (GCT) for handling cargo on goods line no. 4 towards Ambala end of New Shambhu station on DFCCIL/Railway Land. The tender is conducted under a Two Packet System with a single percentage offer for Terminal Charges and Terminal Access Charges. Bids are to be submitted by 15 September 2026 15:00.

  • Tender No: HQ-OPBD0BDGFTD112023-D
  • Closing Date & Time: 15/09/2026 15:00
  • Pre-Bid Conference: 17/08/2026 15:30
ItemDetail

Validity90 days

data.summary: The schedule outlines the verification process for candidates on the waiting list for the Junior Manager (Finance) position in DFCCIL. Candidates can refer to the official notice for details on verification dates and procedures.
data.article_html:
Document Verification Schedule for the post of Jr. Manager/Finance from Waiting LIst

The schedule outlines the verification process for candidates on the waiting list for the Junior Manager (Finance) position in DFCCIL. It provides details on required documents, verification dates, and procedures to be followed by applicants.

  • Verification will be conducted on specified dates.
  • Applicants must bring original documents and photocopies.
  • Failure to attend may result in disqualification.

Experience LettersFull‑time experience certificates
Identity ProofAadhaar/PAN

1  Description :-   (Please see Annexure-VIII of RFP) i) The bidder shall fill the rate at the designated field in IREPS. Quoting rate anywhere in the bid except at the designated field of IREPS shall not be considered for evaluation. ii) Bidder has to quote the rate only in the financial packet of Bid, quoting rate in the technical packet would render the bid summarily rejected. iii) "Bidder will be required to quote the percentage in share of Terminal Charge and Terminal Access Charges (TC/TAC) which they will claim from the Railway for all traffic handled at the Terminal. Eligible bidder asking for the minimum %share or claiming least share of TC/TAC will be awarded the contract where the quoted% rates will be evaluated as follows: (i) If a bidder quotes 100%, it shall mean in effect that bidder claims to be allocated 100% of the TC and TAC amount and IR will retain 'Nil' share of the TC/TAC. (ii) If a bidder quotes 1-99% e.g. 10%, it shall mean in effect that bidder claims to be allocated 10% of the TC/TAC amount, as GCTO share; and remaining 90% being allocated to the IR. (iii) If a bidder quotes "0 (Nil)%", it shall mean in effect that Bidder claims to be allocated 'Nil' share in TC/TAC amount, as GCTO share. (iv) If a bidder quotes in negative, e.g. (-)30%, it means that entire 100% of TC and/or TAC will be retained by IR. Over and above, the GCTO will pay an amount equivalent to 30% of TC and/or TAC to IR. (v) Thus, if five bids are received with quotes 100%, 30%, 0%, -20% and -40%; in such case, -40% is the minimum bid, and this bidder shall be awarded the contract. The financial bid (Packet-B) of the tender document will contain only the rate offered (percentage of Terminal Charges & Terminal Access Charges) by the bidder which it will claim from DFCCIL/railways 2.   Contract   shall   be   awarded   to   the   eligible   bidder   bidding   the   minimum   percentage   share   or claiming least share of Terminal Charges & Terminal Access Charges (TC & TAC). Minimum% share will be calculated as per the procedure laid down at para 4 below. 3. A single percentage offer rate must be quoted by the bidder for Terminal Charges & Terminal Access Charges (TC & TAC). 4. The maximum share which the bidder can claim is by quoting a rate of 100% of TC/TAC. In case the bidder quotes more than "100%" then the bid shall be rejected. The quoted percentage rates will be evaluated as follows: Say for example, (i) If a bidder quotes "100%", it shall mean in effect that bidder claims to be allocated 100% of the TC and TAC amount, and that DFCCIL/IR will retain "nil" share of TC/TAC. (ii) If a bidder quotes 10 %, it shall mean that bidder claims to be allocated [10%] of TC/TAC amount (as mentioned cell 1B of the table), as GCTO share, and remaining 90% being allocated to DFCCIL/IR. (iii) If bidder quotes "-30%", it means that entire 100% of TC and/or TAC will be retained by Indian Railways. Over and above, the GCTO will pay an amount equivalent to 30% of TC and/or TAC to DFCCIL/IR. For eg., if five bids are received with rates quoted as "100%", "30%", "0%, "-20", and -40% in such case "-40%" is the minimum bid. In this case, the bidder is offering to not only claim nil share of TC and/or TAC but also offering to pay an amount equivalent to 40% of TC and/or TAC to DFCCIL/IR  3. data.article_html:
Document verification schedule for the post of Junior Executive/S&T from the waiting list

DFCCIL has issued the schedule for the verification of documents for candidates on the waiting list for the post of Junior Executive in the Silica & Technology (S&T) division.

  • The verification will commence on 15th October 2023 and will continue for a specified period.
  • Each candidate will be assigned a specific time slot for document scrutiny.
  • All original certificates and relevant documents must be presented at the verification venue.

Candidates are required to attend on the allotted date and time without fail to complete the verification process.

data.summary: The President of India, through DFCCIL, has invited tenders for the planning, construction, development and operation of a Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal on the New Delhi–Ambala railway line. Bids are evaluated on the percentage share of terminal charges and access charges, with the lowest percentage share winning. The submission deadline is 15 September 2026, and a pre-bid conference will be held on 17 August 2026.
data.article_html:
Notice Inviting Tender – Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal

The President of India, through DFCCIL, has invited tenders for the planning, construction, development and operation of a Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal (GCT) on the New Delhi–Ambala railway line, covering goods line No. 4 towards Ambala end of New Shambhu station.

  • Tender No: HQ-OPBD0BDGFTD112023-D
  • Submission deadline: 15 September 2026, 15:00 hrs
  • Pre-bid conference: 17 August 2026, 15:30 hrs
  • Bid type: Normal Tender, Two-Packet System
  • Earnest Money: Rs 33,340,300
  • Validity of offer: 90 days

structured_data.summary: The President of India, through DFCCIL, has invited tenders for the planning, construction, development and operation of a Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal on the New Delhi–Ambala railway line. Bids are evaluated on the percentage share of terminal charges and access charges, with the lowest percentage share winning. The submission deadline is 15 September 2026, and a pre-bid conference will be held on 17 August 2026.
structured_data.article_html:
Notice Inviting Tender – Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal

The President of India, through DFCCIL, has invited tenders for the planning, construction, development and operation of a Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal (GCT) on the New Delhi–Ambala railway line, covering goods line No. 4 towards Ambala end of New Shambhu station.

  • Tender No: HQ-OPBD0BDGFTD112023-D
  • Submission deadline: 15 September 2026, 15:00 hrs
  • Pre-bid conference: 17 August 2026, 15:30 hrs
  • Bid type: Normal Tender, Two-Packet System
  • Earnest Money: Rs 33,340,300
  • Validity of offer: 90 days
  • Contract period: 18 months
  • Opportunity to claim share of Terminal Charges and Terminal Access Charges (TC/TAC) as low as –40 %

data.summary: DFCCIL has invited tenders for the comprehensive maintenance of Cummins NTA-855R diesel engines used in Twin Drive Under Slung cars for a two-year period. The tender, identified as DFC-ADI-EL-T-14-26-27, closes on 4 September 2026 at 15:00 hours. Bids must be submitted electronically before the deadline.
data.article_html:
DFCCIL Tender Notice – Maintenance of Cummins Engines

The Delhi Financial Corporation (DFCCIL) has issued a tender (No. DFC-ADI-EL-T-14-26-27) inviting bids for the comprehensive maintenance of Cummins NTA‑855R diesel engines installed in Twin Drive Under Slung cars for a two‑year period.

  • Tender Closing Date: 04 September 2026 at 15:00 hrs
  • Uploading Date: 08 August 2026
  • Contract Period: 24 months
  • Earnest Money: Rs. 214,300
  • Validity of Offer: 90 days

The tender, identified as DFC-ADI-EL-T-14-26-27, closes on 4 September 2026 at 15:00 hours. Bids must be submitted electronically before the deadline.
structured_data.article_html:
DFCCIL Tender Notice – Maintenance of Cummins Engines

The Delhi Financial Corporation (DFCCIL) has issued a tender (No. DFC-ADI-EL-T-14-26-27) inviting bids for the comprehensive maintenance of Cummins NTA‑855R diesel engines installed in Twin Drive Under Slung cars for a two‑year period.

  • Tender Closing Date: 04 September 2026 at 15:00 hrs
  • Uploading Date: 08 August 2026
  • Contract Period: 24 months
  • Earnest Money: Rs. 214,300
  • Validity of Offer: 90 days

data.article_html:
Notice Inviting Tender for Gati Shakti Multi‑Modal Cargo Terminal

The Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) invites bids for the planning, construction, development and operation of a Gati Shakti Multi‑Modal Cargo Terminal (GCT) on the goods line No. 4 towards Ambala end of New Shambhu station on DFCCIL railway land. The tender follows a two‑packet single‑rate system under the Open Normal Tender procedure.

  • Tender No: HQ-OPBD0BDGFTD112023-D
  • Closing Date & Time: 15/09/2026 15:00
  • Bid Validity: 90 days
  • Earnest Money: Rs 33,340,300.00
  • Contract Period: 18 months

Bidders must quote a percentage share of Terminal Charges and Terminal Access Charges (TC/TAC). The minimum quoted percentage determines the award; a bid of –40% is the lowest and would retain 100% of TC/TAC for Indian Railways while the bidder pays 40% of TC/TAC to DFCCIL/IR.

data.article_html:
IBBI 7th National Online Quiz on Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016

The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI), in collaboration with MyGov and BSE Investors Protection Fund, has launched the 7th National Online Quiz on the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC), 2016 to spread awareness and understanding among Indian citizens.

Important Dates

  • Quiz Start Date: 15th July 2026 (00:01 hrs)
  • Quiz End Date: 15th August 2026 (24:00 hrs)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to Indian citizens aged 18 years and above.
  • Individuals working in IBBI, BSE Investors Protection Fund, and registered service providers under IBC (and their immediate family members) are not eligible to participate.

Quiz Structure & Pattern

  • Total Questions: 20 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
  • Time Duration: 10 minutes
  • Medium: English and Hindi
  • Marking Scheme: 1 mark per question; No negative marking

Prizes & Rewards

Rank / CategoryPrize / Reward
1st PerformerGold Medal + ₹1,00,000 Cash Prize
2nd PerformerSilver Medal + ₹50,000 Cash Prize
3rd PerformerBronze Medal + ₹25,000 Cash Prize
Next 20 PerformersConsolation Prize of ₹5,000 each

For further details or clarifications, candidates can contact via email at workshop.ip@ibbi.gov.in or visit official websites at www.ibbi.gov.in and quiz.mygov.in.

data.article_html:
DFCCIL Junior Executive (S&T) Standby Panel DV & PEMT Schedule

Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) has issued a notice regarding the Document Verification (DV) and Pre-Employment Medical Test (PEMT) schedule for standby candidates for the post of Junior Executive/S&T against Advt. No. 01/DR/2023.

Cut-off Marks of Standby Panel Candidates

CategoryFinal Cut-off Marks
Un-reserved (UR)88.2051
Other Backward Classes (OBC)88.7179
ExSM56.6667

Schedule Details

  • Document Verification (DV) Date: 04-Dec-2025 (at 09:30 AM)
  • Medical Examination (PEMT) Date: 05-Dec-2025
  • Venue: DFCCIL Corporate Office Complex, Sector – 145, Noida – 201306 (U.P.)

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • E-mail and SMS are being sent to shortlisted candidates to download their e-admit card for Document Verification.
  • Candidates must bring original certificates along with one set of self-attested photocopies as listed in the official checklist (10th certificate, educational/diploma/degree certificates, category certificates, NOC if applicable, CBT admit card, photo ID, photos, etc.).
  • Completion of DV will be followed by the medical test on the next day. No hotel charges or incidental expenses will be reimbursed.

Eligible bidder asking for the minimum %share or claiming least share of TC/TAC will be awarded the contract where the quoted% rates will be evaluated as follows: (i) If a bidder quotes 100%, it shall mean in effect that bidder claims to be allocated 100% of the TC and TAC amount and IR will retain 'Nil' share of the TC/TAC. (ii) If a bidder quotes 1-99% e.g. 10%, it shall mean in effect that bidder claims to be allocated 10% of the TC/TAC amount, as GCTO share; and remaining 90% being allocated to the IR. (iii) If a bidder quotes "0 (Nil)%", it shall mean in effect that Bidder claims to be allocated 'Nil' share in TC/TAC amount, as GCTO share. (iv) If a bidder quotes in negative, e.g. (-)30%, it means that entire 100% of TC and/or TAC will be retained by IR. (v) Thus, if five bids are received with quotes 100%, 30%, 0%, -20% and -40%; in such case, -40% is the minimum bid, and this bidder shall be awarded the contract. Minimum% share will be calculated as per the procedure laid down at para 4 below. 3. A single percentage offer rate must be quoted by the bidder for Terminal Charges & Terminal Access Charges (TC & TAC). 4. The maximum share which the bidder can claim is by quoting a rate of 100% of TC/TAC. In case the bidder quotes more than "100%" then the bid shall be rejected. The quoted percentage rates will be evaluated as follows: Say for example, (i) If a bidder quotes "100%", it shall mean in effect that bidder claims to be allocated 100% of the TC and TAC amount, and that DFCCIL/IR will retain "nil" share of TC/TAC. (ii) If a bidder quotes 10 %, it shall mean that bidder claims to be allocated [10%] of TC/TAC amount (as mentioned cell 1B of the table), as GCTO share, and remaining 90% being allocated to DFCCIL/IR. (iii) If bidder quotes "-30%", it means that entire 100% of TC and/or TAC will be retained by Indian Railways. Over and above, the GCTO will pay an amount equivalent to 30% of TC and/or TAC to DFCCIL/IR. For eg., if five bids are received with rates quoted as "100%", "30%", "0%, "-20", and -40% in such case "-40%" is the minimum bid. data.article_html:
DFCCIL Gati Shakti Cargo Terminal (GCT) Tender 2026

Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) acting on behalf of the President of India invites open E-Tenders for the work of planning, constructing, developing, and operating a Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal (GCT) for cargo handling on goods line no. 4 towards Ambala end of New Shambhu station on DFCCIL/Railway land.

Tender Overview

  • Tender No: HQ-OPBD0BDGFTD112023-D
  • Type of Tender: Open Tender / Two Packet System
  • Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): ₹3,33,40,300.00
  • Construction Period: 18 Months
  • Validity of Offer: 90 Days

Important Dates

ActivityDate & Time
Date of Uploading Tender05-08-2026 17:21
Pre-Bid Conference Date17-08-2026 15:30
Bidding Start Date01-09-2026
Tender Closing Date & Time15-09-2026 15:00

Eligibility Criteria

  • Technical Experience: Bidders must have at least 2 years of experience in manufacturing, transportation, or logistics and related business. Joint Ventures (JV) with up to 3 members are allowed.
  • Financial Requirement: Net worth of the applicant must be at least 50% of the estimated cost of the project. Revenue from eligible sectors should be at least 35% of the estimated cost for any two financial years during the last five years.

No. 01/DR/2023. A total of 15 candidates are called for document verification on December 4, 2025.
data.article_html:
DFCCIL Junior Executive (S&T) DV & PEMT Schedule 2025

Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) has issued the schedule for Document Verification (DV) and Pre-Employment Medical Test (PEMT) for the post of Junior Executive/S&T from the waiting list against Advertisement No. 01/DR/2023.

Venue & Reporting Details

Venue: DFCCIL Corporate Office Complex, Sector – 145, Noida – 201306 (U.P.)
Reporting Time: 09:30 AM

Cut-off Marks of Standby Panel

CategoryFinal Cut-off Marks
Un-reserved (UR)88.2051
Other Backward Classes (OBC)88.7179
ExSM56.6667

Important Information for Candidates

  • Candidates must bring original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies as specified in Annexure-I.
  • Admit card download links will be sent via email/SMS to shortlisted candidates.
  • Completing DV and Medical fitness test does not confer any right to final appointment.

data.summary: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) invites open e-tenders for planning, constructing, developing, and operating a Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal (GCT) at New Shambhu station. data.article_html:
DFCCIL Notice Inviting Tender (NIT) Details

Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL), acting for and on behalf of the President of India, invites online open tenders under the Two Packet System for the planning, construction, development, and operation of a Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal (GCT) for handling cargo on goods line no. 4 towards Ambala end of New Shambhu station on DFCCIL/Railway Land under Schedule-2 of the GCT Policy of Indian Railways.

Key Specifications

Tender NumberHQ-OPBD0BDGFTD112023-D
Tender TypeOpen Tender (Two Packet System)
Earnest Money (EMD)Rs. 3,33,40,300.00
Tender Document CostRs. 0.00
Construction Period18 Months
Validity of Offer90 Days

Important Dates

  • Uploading Date: 05-08-2026
  • Pre-Bid Conference: 17-08-2026 at 15:30 Hrs
  • Bidding Start Date: 01-09-2026
  • Closing Date & Time: 15-09-2026 at 15:00 Hrs

Eligibility Criteria

  • Experience: Bidders (or JV members) must have at least 2 years of experience in manufacturing, transportation, or logistics and related business.
  • Net Worth: Minimum net worth must be at least 50% of the estimated project cost.
  • Sector Revenue: Revenue from eligible sectors should be at least 35% of the estimated cost of the project for any two financial years during the last 5 years.

data.title: Nainital Bank KYC Updation Pending Notice - Submit KYC to Avoid Account Freeze
data.original_title: KYC UPDATION PENDING- SUBMIT KYC AT YOUR BRANCH The customers are requested to submit the KYC to the bank otherwise the account will be freezed.
data.summary: Nainital Bank has published an urgent notification for customers with pending KYC updation. Account holders listed in the notice are requested to submit their updated KYC documents at their respective branches immediately to prevent account freezing.
data.article_html:
Nainital Bank Notice: Pending KYC Updation

The Nainital Bank Limited has issued an urgent public notice for account holders whose Know Your Customer (KYC) compliance is pending across various branches in Delhi, Dehradun, Haldwani, and other regions.

Customers whose names appear in the official list are strongly advised to visit their home branch and complete the KYC process immediately. Non-compliance will result in the freezing of the affected bank accounts.

Key Instructions for Account Holders

  • Action Required: Visit your respective bank branch where the account is held.
  • Documents Required: Valid government-issued Photo ID proof, Address proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
  • Consequence of Delay: Accounts with unverified or pending KYC will be debit-frozen as per RBI guidelines.

Affected Regions and Branches

The notification affects account holders across various branches including Noida Sector 50, Pitampura (Delhi), Ranibagh, Lalkuan, Bilaspur Rampur, Shahjahanpur, Pilibhit, Bageshwar, Champawat, Tanakpur, and other regional offices of Nainital Bank.

data.summary: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) has announced the Document Verification (DV) and Pre-Employment Medical Test (PEMT) schedule for shortlisted standby panel candidates for the post of Junior Manager (Finance) under Advt. data.article_html:
DFCCIL Jr. Manager (Finance) DV & PEMT Schedule Notice

Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) has issued a notification regarding the Document Verification (DV) and Pre-Employment Medical Test (PEMT) schedule for candidates shortlisted from the standby panel for the post of Jr. Manager/Finance against Advt. No. 01/DR/2025.

Venue & Reporting Time

Shortlisted candidates are required to report at the venue given below at 09:30 AM on the specified date positively:

Venue: DFCCIL Corporate Office Complex, Sector – 145, Noida – 201306 (U.P.)

Cut-off Marks of Standby Panel Candidates

CategoryFinal Cut-off Marks
Un-reserved (UR)84.5000
Other Backward Classes (OBC-NCL)77.5000

List of Shortlisted Candidates

S.No.Roll NumberDate of DVDate of PEMT
125152733000705.06.202606.06.2026
225163133000805.06.202606.06.2026

Key Instructions for Candidates

  • Candidates will receive SMS and email notifications containing links to download their e-admit cards with complete details and instructions.
  • Failure to report for Document Verification or Medical Examination on the scheduled date and time will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Candidates must bring original documents along with one set of self-attested copies as per Annexure-I checklist.
  • Candidates completing DV will be sent for medical examination on the following day and should come prepared accordingly.
  • No hotel charges or incidental expenses incurred will be reimbursed by DFCCIL.

Document Verification Checklist (Annexure-I)

  • Matriculation/10th Board Certificate and Marksheet (Proof of Date of Birth).
  • SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD/Ex-servicemen certificates in prescribed format. OBC-NCL and EWS certificates must not be older than 1 year.
  • Essential Qualification Degree/Diploma certificates and semester/year-wise mark sheets.
  • Percentage conversion formula document if grades/CGPA are awarded by the University/Institute.
  • NOC from present employer for candidates currently employed in Government/PSU/Autonomous bodies.
  • Printout of Document Verification e-admit card and CBT e-admit cards.
  • 5 latest passport size color photographs, Aadhaar Card, and PAN Card.

data.body: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL)
data.summary: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) invites open e-tenders for the planning, construction, development, and operation of a Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal (GCT) at New Shambhu station. The bidding process is managed online via IREPS under a Two-Packet System with a closing date of September 15, 2026.
data.article_html:
DFCCIL Notice Inviting Tender (NIT) Overview

General Manager (BD), DFCCIL, acting on behalf of the President of India, invites online open tenders for the establishment and operation of a Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal (GCT) on goods line no. 4 towards the Ambala end of New Shambhu station on DFCCIL/Railway land under Schedule '2' of the GCT Policy of Indian Railways.

Key Details & Financial Summary

Tender Reference No.HQ-OPBD0BDGFTD112023-D
Tender TypeOpen Tender (Two Packet System)
Earnest Money Deposit (EMD)Rs. 3,33,40,300.00
Tender Document CostRs. 0.00
Construction Period18 Months
Offer Validity90 Days

Eligibility Criteria

  • Financial Criteria: Net worth of the applicant must be at least 50% of the estimated project cost. Revenue from eligible sectors must be at least 35% of the estimated cost for any two financial years during the last five years.
  • Technical Criteria: The applicant (or any JV member) must have at least two years of experience in manufacturing, transportation, logistics, or related business.
  • Joint Venture (JV): Joint Ventures are allowed with a maximum of up to 3 members. Consortia are not permitted.

Submission Guidelines

Bidders are required to submit their offers strictly through the IREPS portal before 15:00 Hrs on September 15, 2026. Manual offers will be rejected. Bidders must quote their single percentage share rate in the financial bid packet only.

data.article_html:
MP ESB Combined Recruitment Test 2026 - Second Phase Shortlist Released

The MP Employees Selection Board (MP ESB), Bhopal has officially declared the list of candidates eligible for the Second Phase of the Van Rakshak & Kshetra Rakshak, Jail Prahari & Asst. Jail Superintendent Combined Recruitment Test-2026.

Overview of Notification

  • Exam Body: MP Employees Selection Board (MP ESB), Bhopal
  • Test Name: Combined Recruitment Test-2026
  • Document Type: List of Candidates Eligible for Second Phase

Posts Covered

  • Vanrakshak evam Kshetra Rakshak (Direct)
  • Jail Prahari (Direct)
  • Sahayak Jail Adhikshak / Asst. Jail Superintendent (Direct)

Qualified candidates have been categorized into various selection pools (including 87% main list and 13% provisional lists for UR/OBC) based on their application numbers and merit in the recruitment examination. Candidates are advised to check their application number to verify their eligibility for the physical test and subsequent selection phases.

14 th   August 2026   Page   1   of   31  :: Join IndianOil – Fuel Your Career::  RECRUITMENT OF EXECUTIVES IN INDIAN OIL CORPORATION LIMITED THROUGH COMPUTER BASED TEST (CBT) - 2026 Advt. No.: IOCL/CO-HR/RECTT/2026/01   Dated: 14 th   August, 2026 Detailed Advertisement Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IndianOil)   is one of India’s diversified energy major with a significant presence across the hydrocarbon value chain, spanning refining, pipelines, marketing, petrochemicals, natural gas, and emerging energy businesses. As a Maharatna Central Public Sector Enterprise and India’s flagship energy company, IndianOil has been fuelling the nation’s growth for over six decades through its extensive   infrastructure,   operational   excellence,   and   unwavering   commitment   to   energy   security. Consistently ranked among the Fortune Global 500 companies, IndianOil continues to play a pivotal role in powering the lives of millions of Indians every day. Guided by its vision of “The Energy of India,” IndianOil is transforming itself into a future-ready, technology- driven energy enterprise. The Corporation is actively advancing India’s energy transition through strategic investments in Biofuels, Green Hydrogen, Carbon Capture, Utilisation and Storage (CCUS), Renewable Energy, LNG, City Gas Distribution (CGD), and next-generation mobility solutions, while strengthening its leadership in refining and petrochemicals. Through its flagship transformation initiative of SPRINT, IndianOil is fostering innovation, digitalization, sustainability, and operational excellence across the organization to create enduring value for all stakeholders and realize its aspiration of becoming “A Globally Admired Energy Company.” To support its next phase of growth and transformation, IndianOil invites applications from dynamic and enthusiastic candidates of   Indian nationality   with an outstanding academic record for   Executive positions. data.article_html:
Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL) Executive Recruitment 2026

Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL), a Maharatna Central Public Sector Enterprise, has announced recruitment for dynamic candidates for Executive positions across various domains including Engineering, Marketing, Law, Quality Control, and Diploma Engineering through a Computer Based Test (CBT).

Vacancy & Qualification Details

Domain / PostGradeQualification RequiredMinimum Marks Required
Graduate EngineerGrade AB.E. / B.Tech or equivalent in Chemical, Civil, CS/IT, Electrical, E&C, Instrumentation, Mechanical65% (Gen/EWS/OBC-NCL), 55% (SC/ST/PwBD)
Officer (Marketing)Grade A2 Years Full-Time MBA / PGDBA with specialization in Marketing Management60% (Gen/EWS/OBC-NCL), 55% (SC/ST/PwBD)
Officer (Law)Grade AGraduate + LLB OR 5-Year Integrated LLB (Recognized by BCI)60% (Gen/EWS/OBC-NCL), 55% (SC/ST/PwBD)
Assistant Quality Control OfficerGrade A0Master's Degree in Chemistry (Organic, Inorganic, Analytical, Physical, Applied, Industrial)60% (Gen/EWS/OBC-NCL), 55% (SC/ST/PwBD)
Diploma EngineerGrade E03-Year Diploma in Electrical, Mechanical, or Safety Engineering65% (Gen/EWS/OBC-NCL), 55% (SC/ST/PwBD)

Eligible Engineering Disciplines

  • Chemical: Chemical, Chemical Tech, Petrochemical, Petroleum Refinery
  • Civil: Civil Engineering, Civil & Environmental, Construction Technology
  • Computer Science & IT: CS, IT, AI & ML, Cyber Security, Data Science, Software Engg
  • Electrical: Electrical, Electrical & Electronics, Electrical & Power
  • Mechanical: Mechanical, Automation, Production, Design

Selection Process

Selection will be conducted through a national-level Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by shortlisting for further selection rounds as per IOCL norms.

data.body: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited
data.summary: DFCCIL has announced the Document Verification (DV) and Pre-Employment Medical Test (PEMT) schedule for shortlisted candidates from the standby panel for the post of Jr. Manager/Finance (Advt. No. 01/DR/2025). Candidates are required to report at the DFCCIL Corporate Office in Noida on June 5, 2026.
data.article_html:
DFCCIL Jr. Manager/Finance DV & Medical Test Schedule

Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) has issued a notice regarding the schedule for Document Verification (DV) and Pre-Employment Medical Test (PEMT) for the post of Junior Manager/Finance against Advt. No. 01/DR/2025. Shortlisted candidates from the standby panel must attend the process as per the schedule below.

Event Schedule & Venue Details

  • Reporting Time: 09:30 AM
  • Document Verification Date: June 5, 2026
  • Medical Examination Date: June 6, 2026
  • Venue: DFCCIL Corporate Office Complex, Sector-145, Noida - 201306 (U.P.)

Cut-off Marks for Standby Panel

CategoryFinal Cut-off Marks
Un-reserved (UR)84.5000
Other Backward Classes (OBC-NCL)77.5000

List of Shortlisted Candidates

S.No.Roll NumberDV DatePEMT Date
125152733000705.06.202606.06.2026
225163133000805.06.202606.06.2026

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Candidates must bring original certificates along with one set of self-attested photocopies as detailed in the checklist (10th mark sheet, category certificate, NOC if applicable, admit card, PAN card, Aadhaar card, 5 recent passport photos, etc.).
  • E-admit card and detailed instructions are sent via email/SMS.
  • Failure to attend on the stipulated date will lead to cancellation of candidature.

data.summary: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) invites open e-tenders for planning, constructing, developing, and operating a Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal (GCT) at New Shambhu station. Interested bidders meeting the technical and financial criteria can submit bids electronically up to 15th September 2026.
data.article_html:
DFCCIL Gati Shakti Cargo Terminal Tender Details

General General Manager/BD/DFCCIL, acting on behalf of the President of India, invites open e-tenders (Two Packet System) for work under Tender No. HQ-OPBD0BDGFTD112023-D.

Project Scope

The work involves planning, constructing, developing, and operating a Gati Shakti Multi-Modal Cargo Terminal (GCT) for handling cargo on goods line no. 4 towards the Ambala end of New Shambhu station on DFCCIL/Railway Land under Schedule-2 of the GCT Policy of Indian Railways.

Key Tender Details

  • Tender Type: Open Tender (Normal Bidding System)
  • Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): Rs. 3,33,40,300.00
  • Construction Period: 18 Months
  • Validity of Offer: 90 Days
  • Joint Ventures (JV): Allowed (Max 3 members)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Technical Criteria: Bidders must have at least 2 years of experience in manufacturing, transportation, or logistics and related business. Revenue from eligible sectors should be at least 35% of the estimated project cost in any two financial years during the last five years.
  • Financial Criteria: The net worth of the applicant must be at least 50% of the estimated cost of the project.

On-line Applications   are invited from bright, young and energetic persons of Indian Nationality for the following posts in the pay scale of  Rs.11,900-32,000/- (under revision) :  Code   Name of Post   Vacancies  Total   UR   SC   ST   OBC (NCL)   PwBD   EXM  1   2   3   4   5   6   7   8   9  101   Junior   Engineering   Assistant-IV (Production)   27   6   4   15 #   2   ---  As per Govt. guidelines.  102   Junior Engineering Assistant-IV (P&U- O&M)   5   3   1   1   --   --  103  Junior   Engineering   Assistant-IV (Mechanical)/Junior   Technical Assistant-IV  3   2   --   --   1   1 (PV-1)  104  Junior   Engineering   Assistant-IV (Instrumentation)/Junior   Technical Assistant - IV  5   2   1   1 #   1   1 (PH-1)  # Backlog vacancies Abbreviations :   UR – Unreserved, SC – Scheduled Caste, ST – Scheduled Tribe, OBC (NCL) – Other Backward Castes (Non Creamy Layer), PwBD-Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PH) – Hard of Hearing (PV) – Low vision. EXM – Ex-Servicemen  *PwBD candidates may apply in terms of the notified categories of disability under Clause D (5) below.  1.   Positions are operated with work arrangements in one, two or three shifts. Incumbents may be required to perform duties in any of the work arrangements depending upon work exigencies.  2.   Number of vacancies indicated above is tentative and may increase or decrease in the relevant categories at the absolute discretion of the management and in compliance with the Presidential Directives on reservation at the time of appointment.  3.   Petroleum Refining is a complex and hazardous process and candidates belonging to Persons with Benchmark Disabilities category (40% or higher) are not deployed.   Such candidates may be considered only against identified positions/numbers, as indicated above.  The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016   -   Section 2(r) defines “person with benchmark disability” as a person duly certified by the certifying authority with:     not less than 40% of a specified disability where specified disability has not been defined in measurable terms and     a disability where specified disability has been defined in measurable terms.  The candidates are required to submit a Disability   Certificate issued by competent authority as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules,  2017,   failing which their candidature as PwBD candidates will not be considered. Persons with Benchmark Disabilities must be capabl e of performing  the task assi gned to them/take instructions using suitable aids and appliances.   Appointment of candidates   belonging to PwBD categor ies   will be  from categories below against identified posts under categories notified at   A ( 3 )   and   A ( 4 )   below:  1.   PV-Low vision   P=Physical;   V=Vision;   H=Hearing; L=Locomotors;   O=Orthopaedic;  OA=One Arm;  OL=One Leg  2.   PH-Hard of hearing  3.   PL-Musculoskeletal (OH-OA/OL), Dwarfism, Acid attack victim, Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured  4.   Multiple (a combination of 1,2 or 3 above)  5.   Deaf  Being a hazardous industry, deployment of PwBDs with other Disabilities may put such PwBDs at risk, hence not included.     On - line registration of application commences   on   01 - 08 - 2018   (10:00 Hrs)   and closes on   21 - 08 - 2018   (17:00 Hrs).     The link to the on-line registration of the application has been hosted on the website   www.iocl.com     The Written Test is likely to be held in the month of   September, 2018

No.  Name of Post   Post Code  Qualification (Full Time Regular Courses only from Indian Universities/ Institutes)  Area of Experience  1   Junior Engineering Assistant-IV (Production)  101   3   years   Diploma   in   Chemical/   Refinery   & Petrochemical   Engg.   or   B.Sc.   (Maths,   Physics, Chemistry   or   Industrial   Chemistry)   from   a recognized Institute/ University with minimum of 50%   marks   in   aggregate   for   General   &   OBC candidates & 45% marks in aggregate in case of SC/ST candidates against reserved positions.  Minimum   one   year   of   post   qualification experience in operation (rotating shift) of Pump House,   Fired   Heater,   Compressor,   Distillation Column,   Reactor,   Heat   exchanger   etc.   in   a Petroleum Refinery/   Petrochemicals/   Fertilizer/ Heavy Chemical/ Gas Processing Industry.  2   Junior Engineering Assistant-IV (P&U- O&M)  102   3   years   Diploma   in   Electrical   Engineering   from recognized Institute/ University with minimum of 50%   marks   in   aggregate   for   General   &   OBC candidates & 45% marks in aggregate in case of SC/ST candidates against reserved positions.  Minimum one year post qualification experience in operation of Industrial Boiler/ HRSG/Thermal Power   Station   (DM   plant/RO   plant/Air compressors/   Steam   Turbines/   Gas   turbines/ cooling   tower/RO   Plant/   Air   Compressor   in Petroleum   Refinery/   Petrochemicals/   Heavy Chemical/   Fertilizers/   Power   Plants/   large industrial establishment.  or  Minimum   one   year   of   post   qualification experience in operation/maintenance of Power Generators/ Distribution Sub-Stations (LT & HT at 0.4 KV & 6.6 KV level or above respectively)/ Maintenance of HT/LT Switch gears (PCC/MCC)/ Transformers/Motors/   ACBs/VCBs/   UPS/Battery Chargers/ Variable speed drives/protective relays including   electromagnetic/   Static/   Numerical relays in Petroleum Refinery/ Petro-chemicals/ Heavy Chemical/ Fertilizers / Power Plants/ large industrial establishments.  3   Junior Engineering Assistant-IV (Mechanical)   / Junior Technical Assistant - IV  103   3 years Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from recognized Institute/ University with minimum of 50% marks in aggregate for General, SC, ST & OBC candidates & 45% marks in aggregate in case of PwBD candidates against reserved/ identified for PwBD positions or Matric with ITI in Fitter Trade with Pass class.  Minimum   one   year   of   post   qualification experience in maintenance/ overhauling of rotary equipment such as Compressors, Gas/ Steam Turbines,   Boilers,   Columns,   Valves,   Pumps, Mechanical   Seals/   Dry   gas   seals,   Bearings (Journal/   Anti-friction),   Safety   valves,   etc;   in Petroleum   Refinery/   Petro-chemical/   Heavy Chemical/   Fertilizer/   Power   Plants/   large industrial establishment.  4   Junior Engineering Assistant-IV (Instrumentation)   / Junior Technical Assistant - IV  104   3   years   Diploma   in   Instrumentation/ Instrumentation & Electronics/ Instrumentation & Control Engineering from a recognized Institute/ University   with   minimum   of   50%   marks   in aggregate for General & OBC candidates & 45% marks   in   aggregate   in   case   of   SC/ST/PwBD candidates   against   reserved/identified   for   PwBD positions.  Minimum   one   year   of   post   qualification experience   in   Maintenance   of   Modern instrumentation   control   system   like   DCS,   PLC with   electronic   field   instrumentation,   Control Valve,   Smart   Positioners,   loop   configuration, online Analyzers condition monitoring, cabling, earthing   etc.,   in   a   Petroleum   Refinery/ Petrochemicals/   Heavy   Chemical/   Fertilizers /Power Plants/ Gas Processing Industry/ large industrial establishments.  B.   Important Instructions:  1.   The prescribed qualification should be from a recognized Indian University/Institute as a regular full time course / Diploma course (including a sandwich diploma course with industrial training as part of the course; with no break) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate (45% marks in aggregate for SC/ST and PwBD category candidates   against reserved / identified positions). For ITI (Fitter), only a pass shall be eligible.  2.   Candidates possessing Diploma under recognised lateral entry scheme (Class–XII (Sc.)/ ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course) shall also be considered eligible subject to meeting prescribed percentage of marks on the basis of aggregate of 4 semesters in the diploma course.  3.   Qualification of MSc (Chemistry) shall not be considered a disqualification for post code 101. However, percentage requirement shall be applied on graduation level exam (BSc–PCM) only.  4.   Regular full-time ITI (Fitter) course recognised by NCVT/SCVT shall be considered for Post Code 103.  5.   Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as Engineering Graduates/MBA/MCA/CA/CS/ICWA/LLB or those claiming possession of a Qualification equivalent to the Qualification prescribed shall not be considered for any of the above posts.  6.   A candidate is allowed to apply for only one discipline. In case of receipt of more than one application for more than one discipline, all the applications will be rejected.  7.   Qualification for the purpose of this clause would mean the qualification based on which candidature is offered or considered claimed by a candidate. Prescribed qualification shall be strictly adhered to.
Page   3   of   6  8.   The criteria for full time regular course shall not be insisted upon in case of Ex-Servicemen, provided they possess a requisite EQUIVALENT qualification that has been acquired during the service period and is recognized by AICTE/MHRD, GoI and have secured the prescribed minimum percentage of marks.  9.   The candidature of the applicant would be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates/ testimonials, etc.  10.   Suppression of information regarding possession of or pursuing higher qualification shall render a candidate ineligible for consideration at any stage of selection and termination at any time during employment, if recruited.  11.   Large Industrial Establishment would mean industrial/manufacturing Units whose investment in plant & machineries exceed Rs. 10 crores and which has been in operation.     Candidates shall be required to attach a copy of the relevant page of the last published Balance sheet of the establishment with the physical application under self-certification by the candidate.     Candidates employed, directly or by or through any agency (including a contractor) by a Large Industrial Establishment shall also be eligible to apply, provided they furnish copy of the work order issued to the agency/contractor along with the page of the balance sheet.  12.   Candidates who are registered with Local Employment Exchange(s)/ District Sainik Resettlement Board and meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria, whose names are sponsored to concerned Refinery Unit against this notification, are advised to apply Online, failing which their candidature will not be considered.  13.   A Person with a specified disability listed in the Schedule but not covered under Section 34 (1), if certified by a Certifying Officer as a person with disability of 40% or above, in terms of provisions of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 shall be allowed concessions / relaxations available to PwBDs against post codes 103 and 104 only and if selected on merit against unreserved vacancies, he shall be declared successful. His candidature will not be considered / adjusted against reservation provided to PwBDs under Section 34 (1) of the Act of 2016.  14.   A PwBD candidate availing of any age-relaxation (no relaxation in eligibility qualification marks / in written test qualifying marks) shall be considered against unreserved vacancy in order of merit in the select list before being considered against a reserved post.  15.   Ex-servicemen claiming an equivalence in qualification shall be required to produce a copy of equivalence certificate by the concerned Ministry.  C.   Opportunity for Women:  1.   No woman is permitted to work in or allowed to enter any building in which the generation of gas from dangerous petroleum as defined in the Petroleum Act 1934, is carried on. No woman is allowed to work in LPG storage and handling area.  2.   Accordingly, Women candidates will not be considered for vacancies in Production and also against the cadres/work areas that require shift operations, 365 days in a year or necessitates undertaking work beyond 07.00 pm (& upto 06.00 am), like P&U Operations (Boiler & Electrical) or maintenance services normally performed in shifts. However, subject to limitations above, exemptions if any, work & work performance requirements and availability of identified positions, women may be appointed.  D.   Reservation   for SC/ST/OBC (Non – Creamy Layer)/ExSM/PwBD:  1.   Reservation of Posts for SC/ST/OBC (Non – Creamy Layer)/ExSM/PwBD candidates and relaxations thereof will be in terms of numbers indicated above / as per Govt. guidelines.  2.   SC/ST/OBC candidates can be considered under General standard of merit against the un-reserved posts provided no relaxation in age, qualification etc. is availed of/extended to them.  3.   For claiming the benefit of OBC category, the candidate should submit a latest caste certificate in the proforma prescribed by Govt. of India, which would, among others specifically mention that the candidate does not belong to the persons/sections (creamy layer) as mentioned in column 3 of the schedule to the Department of Personnel & Training, Government of India OM No. 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.1993 & OM No. 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017.  4.   Candidates belonging to OBC category but falling in creamy layer are not entitled to OBC reservation benefits.   Accordingly such candidates may choose to apply for the positions provided they meet the age criteria applicable to UR candidates and indicate their category as “UR”. Indian Oil Corporation Ltd. being a Central Public Sector Undertaking, only those communities that are mentioned in the common list of OBC approved by Central Government shall be treated as OBC for the purpose of reservation. Relevant List can be viewed at   http://www.ncbc.nic.in .  5.   Prescribed reservations for PwBD & Ex-servicemen will be applied on horizontal basis as per Govt. guidelines. Candidates belonging to Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) category shall be considered only against the identified numbers and positions. The identified posts along with categories of disability for appointment of PwBD candidates are as under:  Sl.   Posts   Category of disability  1   Junior Engineering Assistant (Mechanical)/ Junior Technical Assistant - IV  1. PV - Low Vision  2. PH – Hard of hearing  3. PL - Musculoskeletal (OH-OA/OL), Dwarfism, Acid   Attack Victim, Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy cured.  4.   Multiple (A combination of 1, 2 or 3 above).  5.   Deaf  P-Physical ; V- Vision; H-Hearing; L-Locomotors; O-Orthopedic ; H- Handicap  2   Junior   Engineering   Assistant   (Instrumentation)   / Junior Technical Assistant – IV
Page   4   of   6  6.   PwBD candidates with less than 40% of permanent disability are not eligible. The PwBD candidates are required to submit a Disability Certificate issued by competent authority as per the Persons with Disabilities (Equal Opportunities, Protection of Rights and Full Participation) Amended Rules, 2017, failing which their candidature as PwBD candidates will not be considered. Persons with Disabilities [PV, PH and PL] must be capable of performing the task assigned to them.  E.   Other Concessions/Relaxations to SC/ST/OBC/PwBD & Ex-servicemen (EXM) :  1.   The minimum qualifying marks will be relaxed by 5% in written test for candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories against reserved positions.  2.   SC/ST/PwBD candidates called for Written Test and Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test will be reimbursed single IInd class rail fare from the nearest railway station of the mailing address to the place of Written Test and Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test and back by the shortest route on production of ticket, provided the distance is not less than 30 Kms.  3.   SC/ST/PwBD/EXM candidates are exempted from payment of application fee.  F.   Age limit/   Relaxation for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/ Ex-servicemen (EXM) :  1.   Certificate issued by a Board of Secondary Education for passing Matriculation/Higher Secondary shall be the only acceptable document in support of proof of age.  2.   Minimum 18 years and Maximum age shall be 26 years for General candidates as on   31-07-2018 .  3.   Relaxation in age upto 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates considered against reserved positions will be allowed.  4.   PwBD candidates will be allowed age-relaxation upto 10 years (upto 15 years for SC/ST and upto 13 years for OBC candidates), if considered against reserved positions.  5.   Relaxation to Ex-servicemen will be allowed as per Govt. Guidelines i.e in case of EXM, Period of actual military service will be deducted from his actual age and if the resultant age does not exceed the maximum age limit by more than three years, he shall be considered to be fulfilling the age criteria.  6.   PwBD / EXM candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC categories shall be eligible for grant of cumulative age relaxation under the categories.  7.   Age relaxation of a period equal to minimum years of experience notified against a post shall be allowed.  8.   Period of an Apprenticeship training in an industry covered under the experience criteria notified in this advt. relevant to a post will be considered for relaxation in age.  9.   Further, period of an Apprenticeship training in an industry covered under the experience criteria notified in this advt. relevant to a post may be considered as experience.   However, in such cases, relaxation towards age shall not be available.  G.   Consideration for Ex-Apprentices  Apprentices of IOCL completing apprenticeship training in any of IOCL Refineries   on or before 31-07-2018   are also eligible to apply.  H.   Date of reckoning Eligibility criteria:  1.   The date for the purposes of possession of qualification & experience and meeting age criteria shall be   31-07-2018.  I.   Pay & Perks:  1.   Besides Basic Pay and Industrial pattern of DA, the other allowances / benefits include HRA/subsidized housing accommodation (as per availability), Medical Facilities, Productivity/ Performance Related Pay, Gratuity, Contributory Provident Fund, Employees’ Pension Scheme, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Leave Encashment, Leave Travel Concession/LFA, Contributory Superannuation Benefit Fund Scheme, House Building Advance, Conveyance Advance/Maintenance Reimbursement, Children Education Allowance etc., as per Corporation rules.  J.   Selection Methodology:  1.   The selection methodology will comprise Written Test and a Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT) which will be of qualifying nature.  2.   A candidate will have to secure a minimum of 40% marks in the written test to qualify for further consideration.  3.   The minimum qualifying marks in the written test will be relaxed by 5% for candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories considered against reserved positions.  4.   Obtaining minimum qualifying marks in the written test does not confer any right or claim by the candidate for being shortlisted for further consideration or the final selection, as the same is related to number of positions, ratio applied and relative performance in respective categories.  5.   Short listed candidates, in the ratio of 1:2 (two candidates for one post, with due cognizance to number of reserved posts) subject to securing minimum qualifying marks in the written test, will be required to undergo a Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). The SPPT for each discipline shall be conducted by a duly constituted committee.  6.   In case of tie of marks in the written test for the last position on the Shortlist for SPPT, all such candidates shall be called for the SPPT, even if the total number exceeds the prescribed ratio. If such a situation arises anywhere before the last position while drawing a list, the last name/last few names, in proportion to the prescribed ratio, will get eliminated.  7.   Category-wise Merit list shall be drawn on the basis of marks obtained in the written test from & out of the said short-list; only for such candidates who qualify in the SPPT.  8.   In case of tie of marks for the last position on the Merit List, the candidate with prior date of birth (senior by age) shall find a place in the Merit list. However, the name of the junior shall also be retained in the said Merit List, as the last name. If such a situation arises anywhere before the last position while drawing a list, the last name/last few names in the list, in proportion to the prescribed ratio, will get eliminated.
Page   5   of   6  9.   PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates, if found suitable, will be considered against reserved vacancy irrespective of their position in Merit list (in order of merit within the category) on horizontal reservation policy.  10.   The candidature of the applicant would be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates/ testimonials, experience etc.   At any stage of the selection process, if it is found that the candidate has furnished false or incorrect information, the candidature/appointment of the candidate will be cancelled.  11.   Filling up of vacancies is solely at the discretion of the management based on suitability of candidates and no claim will arise for appointment, if some of these vacancies are not filled due to unsuitability of available candidates or insufficiency in number of candidates.  12.   The decision of the Management will be final and binding on all candidates on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of the application, mode of selection, cancellation of the selection process either in part or full, etc. No correspondence will be entertained in this regard.  K.   Pre-Employment Medical and Physical Fitness:  1.   Candidates are advised to ensure that they are medically fit as per Indian Oil's pre-employment medical standard. Candidates are advised to go through the "Guidelines and Criteria for Physical Fitness for Pre-employment medical examination" and satisfy themselves of meeting the fitness criteria before starting the application submission process before they commence the application process. The guidelines are available in the following link :  https://www.iocl.com/PeopleCareers/Pre-employment_Guiding_Principles11th_mar_2011.pdf  L.   Liability to Declare :  1.   Candidates with reported ailments, deficiencies or abnormalities and also those with finding of not meeting the physical fitness criteria as above, shall make a declaration to this effect while submitting their application.  2.   A candidate found UNFIT during medical examination conducted by any refinery unit while seeking engagement as an apprentice in the past shall also be required to declare the same with reasons for being declared UNFIT.  M.   General Instructions :  1.   Candidates are advised to carefully read the full advertisement for details of educational qualification and other eligibility criteria before submission of on-line application.  2.   A candidate employed in Govt/Govt Departments/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies will be required to submit ‘NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE’ at the time of Written Test, failing which the candidate will not be allowed to appear in the Skill/ Proficiency/Physical   Test. Such candidates, if offered an appointment, shall be required to submit proper  ‘RELEASE ORDER’ from their employer at the time of joining, without which they will not be allowed to join.  3.   General and OBC candidates are required to pay Rs.150/- (Rupees One hundred and fifty only) as application fee (non-refundable) though   SBI e-collect   only.  N.   How to Apply: On-Line Application Form  1.   Before applying on-line, a candidate must have an active email ID and a mobile phone number which must remain valid for at-least twelve month period for future communication (including issue of call letters).  2.   The candidate should have the relevant documents/certificates pertaining to age, qualification, caste, experience, Disability Certificate (where applicable), scanned copy of colour photograph and signature in jpg format (size not exceeding 50 KB) ready before applying on-line. The photo and signature in digital form will be required to be uploaded.  3.   Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria for a post, may visit the website of IOCL   www.iocl.com   and apply on-line. The website will remain open from   01-08-2018 (10:00 Hrs) to 21-08-2018 (17:00 Hrs) . Only online mode of applications will be accepted.  Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria for a post, may visit the website   www.iocl.com   go to   ‘What’s New’ > click on Requirement of Experienced Non-Executive Personnel at IOCL, Paradip Refinery.   All future communication with candidates will take place only through website / email / mobile phone. Applications submitted only through on-line mode will be accepted.  4.   After successfully applying / registering on-line applications, the candidates must take a printout of the filled in online application form. data.article_html:
IOCL Paradip Refinery Recruitment 2018

Indian Oil Corporation Limited (Refineries Division), Paradip Refinery has invited online applications from energetic Indian nationals for recruitment to various non-executive positions in the pay scale of Rs.11,900-32,000/- (under revision).

Vacancy Details

Post CodeName of PostTotal Posts
101Junior Engineering Assistant-IV (Production)27
102Junior Engineering Assistant-IV (P&U- O&M)5
103Junior Engineering Assistant-IV (Mechanical) / Junior Technical Assistant-IV3
104Junior Engineering Assistant-IV (Instrumentation) / Junior Technical Assistant-IV5

Eligibility & Qualification Criteria

  • Junior Engineering Assistant-IV (Production): 3 years Diploma in Chemical/Refinery & Petrochemical Engg. or B.Sc. (PCM/Industrial Chemistry) with min. 50% marks (45% for SC/ST) + 1 year relevant experience.
  • Junior Engineering Assistant-IV (P&U-O&M): 3 years Diploma in Electrical Engineering with min. 50% marks (45% for SC/ST) + 1 year relevant experience.
  • Junior Engineering Assistant-IV (Mechanical): 3 years Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Matric with ITI in Fitter Trade + 1 year relevant experience.
  • Junior Engineering Assistant-IV (Instrumentation): 3 years Diploma in Instrumentation/Instrumentation & Electronics/Instrumentation & Control Engineering + 1 year relevant experience.

Important Dates

  • Online Registration Start Date: 01-08-2018 (10:00 Hrs)
  • Online Registration Closing Date: 21-08-2018 (17:00 Hrs)
  • Written Test: September 2018

data.article_html:
MPPSC State Engineering Service Exam 2025 Interview Notice

Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC), Indore has released an official notice (No. 6741/18/2026/Chayan) regarding the interview conduct for the State Engineering Service Examination 2025. The examination is being conducted to fill positions of Assistant Engineer (Civil) and Assistant Engineer (Electrical/Mechanical) in the Water Resources Department and Public Health Engineering Department of MP.

Key Dates & Schedule

  • Advertisement No.: 08/2025 dated 30.12.2025
  • Interview Call Letter Download Date: From 14th August 2026
  • Interview Date: 22nd August 2026
  • Reporting Time: 09:30 AM at MPPSC Office, Residency Area, Indore

Important Instructions for Applicants

Candidates eligible for the interview must download their call letters from the official portal www.mppsc.mp.gov.in starting 14th August 2026. All candidates must ensure mandatory reporting at the MPPSC office by 09:30 AM on the scheduled interview date and carefully follow all conditions mentioned in the interview letter.

data.original_title: Result for the post of Executive (Electrical) against Advt No. 01/DR/2025
data.body: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited
data.summary: DFCCIL has announced the 2nd Stage CBT results for the post of Executive (Electrical) under Advt No. 01/DR/2025. Shortlisted candidates are provisionally empanelled for Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination starting from April 6, 2026.
data.article_html:
DFCCIL Executive (Electrical) CBT 2 Result Released

Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) has declared the result of the 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT) held on 13th December 2025 for the post of Executive (Electrical) against Advertisement No. 01/DR/2025. Candidates whose roll numbers are empanelled in Annexure-I have been shortlisted for Document Verification (DV) and subsequent Medical Examination.

Category-wise Cut-off Marks

Community / CategoryCut-off Marks
Un-reserved (UR)84.7500
Scheduled Caste (SC)80.5000
Scheduled Tribe (ST)70.2500
Other Backward Class (OBC-NCL)88.5000
Economically Weaker Section (EWS)85.2500
Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD)70.0000
Ex-Servicemen48.5000

Document Verification Venue & Details

Candidates shortlisted for Document Verification are required to report to Room No. 721, 7th Floor, DFCCIL Corporate Office Complex, Sector-145, Noida, Uttar Pradesh - 201306 at 09:30 AM on their respective scheduled dates starting from 06th April 2026.

Documents Required for Verification

  • Matriculation/Secondary (10th) Board Certificate and Marksheet for Date of Birth verification.
  • Cast/Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen) in the prescribed format.
  • Final Degree / Diploma / ITI Certificate along with all semester/year mark sheets.
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) for currently employed candidates in Central/State Govt/PSU/Autonomous bodies.
  • Identity proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card) and 5 recent colored passport-size photographs.
  • E-Admit Card printout for CBT and DV.
